title: Do Not Look in the Bag
lines: Sal is on a mat and hugs a bag.
"Do not look in the bag," said Sal.
"It is not a mug. It fits on a kid," said Sal.
Sal pops the hat on Tom. It fits!
Tom hops up and up in the red hat.
scoring_note: This passage says "do not", "it is", "is not". Decodability forbids apostrophes. A child who reads "don't" or "it's" or "isn't" is reading for meaning — do not score it an error.
